violated_contract: A surface that turns a device-provided clock value into a person-visible time must enforce the same plausibility floor the boundary already enforces elsewhere. A pendant that recorded before its clock was ever set stamps audio with a decades-old epoch; the upload gate refuses filenames before 2024-01-01 (utils.request_validation.parse_sync_filename_timestamp), yet the device Catching up card accepted any positive timer_start and stretched its span to "Sep 5, 1985 - now", and On the Way pinned the recording to a 1985 day header.
canonical_prevention: Apply the ingestion gate's product-era floor (first hardware date, mirrored as one named constant) to every display and range computation over device clock values: drop the value from the range and list the row undated while keeping its seconds, and log each drop once per source so a never-set clock is diagnosable. Mirror an existing gate's constant rather than inventing a recency bound: a floor anchored to the product era cannot invert as time passes.
